notes.title: Korean Added!
notes.notes:
Now you can play and learn in Korean!
You can select this language from the options menu at any time.
Enjoy!

notes.notes:

notes.title: Body Bugs Free with Get-A-Grip Chip
notes.notes:
That's right! You'll get a free copy of [i]Get-A-Grip Chip and the Body Bugs[/i] if you buy [i]Get-A-Grip Chip[/i] on Steam!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1572140/GetAGrip_Chip_and_the_Body_Bugs/]Just open up the Steam Store and check out our new game Get-A-Grip Chip and the Body Bugs.[/url]
You should see that you already own the game, and can install it and play it right away!

Get-A-Grip Chip and the Body Bugs sends tiny robotic hero Chip on a new mission: to enter the human body and dismantle digestive distress! In this satisfying 2D platformer, master Chip’s grappling hook and get things flowing through the digestive system. Raise an army of white blood cells to fight off the Body Bugs as you grapple through the body for guts and glory.

Created in partnership with Games For Change, Get-A-Grip Chip and the Body Bugs is available on Steam, Switch, Xbox, iOS, and Android for a steal, at $2.99, and [b]free[/b] on the Redstart Interactive website! Get your edtech on by taking on the Body Bugs today.

notes.title: New Update: Unlockable Skins
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce a free update to Get-A-Grip Chip adding unlockable skins.

Discover and unlock 8 new skins for Chip by completing various challenges throughout the game. 
For the veteran players, this includes one skin that will remove all checkpoints, requiring you to beat each level in a single try!

notes.title: Lunar Sale On Now + Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Get-A-Grip Chip is taking part in the Steam Lunar Sale, and there's never been a better time to pick up a copy! We've been hard at work updating the game and we're very excited to announce that a free update will be coming to Steam on March 25, 2021. 

Alongside a number of improvements and adjustments, this update adds brand new unlockable skins or  "equipment" that can be obtained by rescuing Battery Bots, and completing other challenges. See if you can get them all!

notes.title: Livestream: Winter Sale
notes.notes:
How is everyone doing out there?
Here at Redstart we're hunkering down and getting to work so we can keep delivering you great content as we prepare for winter. Steam is also preparing for winter and the holiday season by running the Winter Sale where you can grab Get-A-Grip Chip, the soundtrack or the game + soundtrack bundle at 25% off! Check it out here today!

In addition to some bug fixes and performance improvements added to the newest build, we have some updates coming in December that are bound to knock your wool socks off (and knowing wool socks, it takes quite a bit to send them flying)! Keep your eyes peeled on our social media accounts and our Discord for an announcement next month!

In the unlikely event that you don't know how you got here:
In Get-A-Grip Chip, you play as Chip and use his handy-dandy grapple claw to zip through the air. Blast your way through 30 levels of soaring, novel, platforming challenges -- with no jump button!

notes.title: Robot grappling-magnet platformer Get-A-Grip Chip is out now and I'm hooked
notes.notes:
A platformer where you can't jump? Well, it's been done before but not quite like this. Get-A-Grip Chip is out now and it's a wonderfully unique indie game worth your time.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/10/robot-grappling-magnet-platformer-get-a-grip-chip-is-out-now-and-im-hooked

notes.title: Release Date October 16th
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce [i]Get-A-Grip Chip[/i] will release on [b]October 16th[/b]!
Be sure to wishlist the game so you'll be notified when it comes out.

Also come join us on discord here to discuss about Get-A-Grip Chip and chat with the devs: https://discord.gg/NMYxQxs

The demo has been updated to include a brand new level, along with a number of content updates, tweaks, adjustments and improvements. Test your grappling prowess against this challenging new gauntlet, and enjoy the new music to go along with it!

Be sure to [b]Wishlist[/b] [i]Get-A-Grip Chip[/i] to stay up to date with Chip-related news and announcements.
